summary: Frontend-only verification of the hidden 5-tap debug reveal on /alert and app.json version bump. All 7 gesture scenarios (a–g) passed on viewport 390x844 against https://quake-alert-18.preview.emergentagent.com. Config check: app.json version === '1.0.4', iOS bundleIdentifier and android.package still 'com.paulvincenti.quakeguard'. Code review of /app/frontend/app/alert.tsx confirms useState<boolean>('showDebug', false), useRef<number[]>(titleTapsRef), onTitleTap uses a 2000ms sliding window and toggles showDebug on the 5th tap, heading is wrapped in <Pressable onPress={onTitleTap} hitSlop={10} testID='alert-title'>, and the debug panel JSX is inside a {showDebug && (…)} conditional. No stray/duplicate JSX; braces/tags balanced. Regression: im-safe-btn still POSTs safe (200), shows alert-success-toast, and auto-navigates to Home; alert-dismiss-btn still returns to Home. No React Native/Expo deprecation issues introduced by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: Implementation matches spec exactly. Minor stylistic note (non-blocking): onTitleTap creates a new array via spread+filter on each tap; fine for a 5-tap window but could be simplified with push+splice if hot-pathed.

Non-blocking: console warns 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — from existing styles in alert.tsx (safeBtn/iconBubble/liveDot), unrelated to this change but worth migrating to boxShadow eventually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hidden 5-tap debug gesture on alert-title works. Panel toggles on 5 taps within 2s, toggles off on next 5 taps, does not appear on 4 taps, and sliding-window correctly drops taps older than 2s. Regression flows (im-safe POST + success toast + auto-nav, dismiss → Home) unaffected. app.json version 1.0.4 confirmed.
test_scenarios_verified: (d) 5 more rapid taps → panel toggles off (count 0)
(f) 4 taps + 2.2s wait + 1 tap → panel does not appear (sliding window drops old taps)
(g) im-safe-btn POSTs safe (200), success toast shown, auto-nav to Home; alert-dismiss-btn returns to Home
